description: This file contains a utility enum 'CameraCapturePipelineSupport' with static methods to prepare and manage camera capture sessions for photos and videos, including warming up sessions, error handling, and configuration of camera settings.

methods.name: preparePhotoSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession configured for photo capture, selecting camera device based on preferences, and adding photo output.

methods.name: prepareMovieSession
methods.description: Prepares an AVCaptureSession for video recording, including optional audio, based on preferred camera and device ID.

methods.name: prepareWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Sets up a movie session, starts it, and pre-warms it asynchronously for performance optimization.

methods.name: withWarmMovieSession
methods.description: Handles warm-up of movie session, executes an async operation with the output, then stops the session.

methods.name: mapMovieSetupError
methods.description: Maps setup errors to a specific error type, distinguishing microphone unavailability.

methods.name: makePhotoSettings
methods.description: Creates AVCapturePhotoSettings with preferred format and quality.

methods.name: capturePhotoData
methods.description: Captures photo data asynchronously with a delegate.

methods.name: warmUpCaptureSession
methods.description: Asynchronous delay to reduce initial blank frames after starting the capture session.

methods.name: positionLabel
methods.description: Returns string representation of camera position.
